subject: Discovery recap & EOQ timing check — StellarApps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:15:00 -0400
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Redwood x StellarApps

Hi Jenna —

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum as we approach the quarter end: 

Summary of discovery:
- Primary use case: real-time personalization in the product feed (6–12 reqs/sec peak, avg 150 tokens per request).
- Key constraints: <1s P95 latency target, SSO + SOC2 required, and proof of unit economics at scale.
- Success signals: pilot with 3 app teams, <20% uplift in latency tail, and predictable monthly spend.

Proposed next steps:
1) Mutual action plan — I attached an editable MAP with milestones (pilot scope, evaluation metrics, procurement checkpoints). [Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx]
2) Tech deep-dive — Marissa (cc'd) can run a short bench/latency walkthrough with your infra team next week.
3) Procurement path — if you can share an initial timeline for budget/approval we can align offer and capacity.

Timing note: I know you mentioned aiming for a July pilot and potentially committing this quarter. EOQ is coming up next week (June 30) — are budget/approval and procurement still on track from your side? If priorities shifted, totally understand — a quick update helps us route capacity and pricing appropriately.

If helpful I can: 1) hold a 30-min slot for the infra walkthrough, or 2) send a condensed pricing + SLA one-pager for your procurement/legal.

Thanks again — happy to be flexible on timing.

Best,
Aditya Rao
